description.en: The members that you want to add to Cloud Firewall.

title.zh: 添加云防火墙成员账号

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于添加云防火墙成员账号。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation is used to add member accounts to Cloud Firewall.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw add-instance-members --members MemberDesc=renewal MemberUid=2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw AddInstanceMembers --region cn-hangzhou --Members.1.MemberDesc renewal --Members.1.MemberUid 2580394279020000 --method POST --force
